title: Sill
tagline: Know what each gig is really worth.
description: Sill is a real-time earnings dashboard for working musicians. Sync your gig calendar, track commute times and payouts, and compute your true hourly rate after travel and expenses. With a Mapbox-powered commute visualizer, Sill shows you which gigs are worth taking and which aren't.
voice: Sill speaks like a sharp, trusted accountant who knows your scene — direct, unsentimental, and always clear about what you're actually earning.
tone: calm, precise, editorial, data-driven, slightly wry

sections.name: The True Rate Gauge
sections.purpose: Immediately show the core value: a true hourly rate that accounts for travel and expenses.
sections.visualBeat: A large animated circular gauge with a monospace numeral in the center, flanked by a breakdown of payout, hours, commute, and expenses.

sections.name: Commute Overlay
sections.purpose: Visualize travel time and its cost in earnings, helping users decide which gigs are worth it.
sections.visualBeat: A dark Mapbox-style map with a pulsing radius around a pin, and a line chart showing how commute time eats into hourly rate.

sections.name: Earnings Trend
sections.purpose: Show performance over time — weekly and monthly trends in earnings and effective rates.
sections.visualBeat: A comparative bar/line chart with monospace labels, highlighting upward trends in accent color.

sections.name: Gig Ledger
sections.purpose: List all gigs with one-click detail on payouts, expenses, and travel, reinforcing the dashboard's utility.
sections.visualBeat: A clean table with rows that expand to show a mini map and a true-rate tag for each gig.

sections.name: Local-First Privacy
sections.purpose: Reassure users that their data stays in their browser, reinforcing trust and simplicity.
sections.visualBeat: A minimal split-screen: left side shows a browser mockup with a lock icon, right side lists 'No server. No cloud. Your data stays yours.'

heroComposition: First viewport: bold DM Sans headline 'Know what each gig is really worth.' with a clear CTA 'Get the true rate' on the left, and on the right a giant animated circular gauge (Sill's logo) displaying a live true hourly rate in monospace numerals.
logoMarkDescription: A quarter-segment circle (pie slice) with a horizontal tick mark at its center, representing the gauge icon that measures true hourly rate — simple, precise, with rounded terminals.
